elements.text: For the men of the eleven-to-seven, No. 3 machine
This handbook is the property of the Company. Keep it in your pocket through the shift and hand it in at the Clerk’s window at seven o’clock.

content: Read this handbook at the start of every shift, beginning at this page.
You will not recall having read it before. This is expected on Third Shift and is no cause for concern. No man on the shift recalls it, and no man is the worse for it.
Read Section 1 now, in the waiting room, before the eleven o’clock whistle. It will take you ten minutes. The rest of the book is yours to read at dinner, or when the machine is running well.
Keep the handbook in your pocket through the shift. Hand it in at the Clerk’s window at seven.

blocks.text: If you find writing in your copy that is not printed, do not read it. You have been issued a defective copy. Hand it to your Foreman at once.
